title: Kristin Ess Returns to Beauty With Otherwise, a Hair Fragrance Brand Launching at Target
summary: Otherwise launches under Ess' new brand development group and holdings company Starseed Beauty Brands.

extraction.key_fact: Kristin Ess가 헤어 프래그런스 브랜드 Otherwise로 뷰티 시장에 돌아왔다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Otherwise launches under Ess' new brand development group and holdings company Starseed Beauty Brands.
